title: LLM Jailbreak Taxonomy: A Mechanism-Grounded Framework for Adversarial Robustness
description: Mechanism-grounded taxonomy of 40 adversarial jailbreak attack patterns organized across 10 categories, mapped to the specific safety alignment assumptions each exploits. Includes a 1,600-trial reproducible simulation harness calibrated to literature-derived ASR distributions for the June 2026 frontier model set (Claude Opus 4-8, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro). Every citation has been audit-verified via direct WebFetch of arxiv abstracts; refuted prior claims documented in the changelog.
